title: You Got The Babysitting Job. Follow The 12 Rules 😨
cta: Tag your jobless friend in the comments
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. Would you take the job? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Congratulations. You got the babysitting job at the Marlow house.
Five thousand a week, cash. Just watch little Nora until sunrise.
At the door, Mrs Marlow smiles too long. If she asks for her brother, say he's asleep.
You check the family photos. There is no brother.
Rule one. Bed at nine. She'll beg for one more story. Read it, or she tells her own. It's about you.
Rule two. Never open her wardrobe. The tapping inside is him, waiting for his turn.
Rule three. If Nora talks to an empty corner, let her. Someone answers from under the bed.
Rule four. At eleven eleven, every toy turns to face the wall. They don't want to see what's in the hall.
Rule five. The baby monitor hums a lullaby. It has no speaker. Unplug it, and the humming moves into the walls.
Rule six. Small handprints on the window? Wipe them off, fast. They are not Nora's.
They're his. And he hates being ignored.
Rule seven. If the hall light comes on by itself, don't look at the door. Count to ten. He'll go back.
Rule eight. You'll find a second glass of milk by her bed. Don't drink it. Don't pour it away. It's his.
Rule nine. At midnight, the family photo changes. If there's a boy in it now, do not count the faces.
Rule ten. If Nora laughs in her sleep, laugh with her, quietly. He has to think you're in on the joke.
Rule eleven. Never ask his name. If Nora tries to whisper it to you, cover your ears.
*Rule twelve. At dawn, the parents come home. Count them. If three people walk in, you broke a rule.
